key_impacts: Loss of life and property reported
Basic services disrupted for months across the state
evidence_snippets: The June 2013 floods and landslides in Uttrakhand would go down as one of the most debilitating disasters.
Loss of life and property along with the disruption of basic services saw the state descend into anarchy for months.
Children and adolescents as a group have been hit the hardest.

key_impacts: People swept away and killed in Kedarnath
Mandakini river broke its course through the town
evidence_snippets: On the morning of 17th June 2013, a raging Mandakini river swept across Kedarnath.
Swallowing Anil along with many others.

key_impacts: School operated from makeshift locations for weeks
Teaching and learning impeded in temporary premises
evidence_snippets: The July 13 landslide has transformed this school's building into a pile of rubble.
The school had to be operated from two makeshift locations in the village.
From 13th August onwards, the school was shifted to the Panchayat premises.
